mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.title AS post_title, p.content AS post_content, p.user_id AS user_id, m.name AS member_name, MAX(u.avatar) AS avatar, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pi.image_url) AS image_urls, pv.view_time AS last_view_time FROM post_view pv JOIN post p ON pv.post_id = p.id JOIN member m ON p.user_id = m.id LEFT JOIN user_profile u ON p.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN post_image pi ON p.id = pi.post_id WHERE pv.user_id = #{userId} AND pv.view_time = ( SELECT MAX(v2.view_time) FROM post_view v2 WHERE v2.post_id = pv.post_id AND v2.user_id = pv.user_id ) AND p.status = '1' GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.content, m.name, pv.view_time, p.user_id ORDER BY pv.view_time DESC
